Quickstart

Get a first response in two minutes.

Install

npm install @nova/sdk

Run

Create index.mjs:

import { Nova } from "@nova/sdk";
const nova = new Nova({ apiKey: process.env.NOVA_API_KEY });
console.log(await nova.ask("ping"));

If everything works, you'll see pong printed.
